candidates.reason: Small active-platform binary, packaged font, direct SVG-to-PNG conversion, stable output, and no browser download.
The active libvips package alone is about 17.3 MiB and exceeds the complete 15 MiB added-payload target; it also carries LGPL-3.0-or-later runtime custody.
Useful as a development visual control, but production would require a downloaded browser and materially larger runtime.
Depends on external CLI/browser availability and violates self-contained offline package requirements.

editableConversion.reason: MIT-compatible but pulls the full Mermaid parser/runtime graph; the production slice uses a smaller deterministic native flowchart scene projection and reports every other grammar unsupported.
